projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.sprintDesc: Duration, start day and sprint naming template.
projectSettings.activeSprintDesc: The board automatically scrolls to the active sprint on open.
projectSettings.spScaleDesc: Define SP values, their description (visible to the team during voting) and duration in working days on the Gantt chart.
projectSettings.taskCoefficientDesc: Duration multiplier when assigning tasks on the Gantt chart. 1.0 = no change, 1.2 = +20%.
projectSettings.inviteLinksDesc: Create links to invite members. Each link can grant SM rights.
projectSettings.membersDesc: Manage roles and rights of project members.
projectSettings.estimationMethodDesc: How the team estimates tasks in planning poker. Only affects voting form and reveal — the final value is always stored as project SP.
projectSettings.methodDesc_COMPOSITE_SP: Voting by 4 criteria: Dev Effort, QA Effort, Risk, Uncertainty. Converts to SP via median.
projectSettings.methodDesc_FIBONACCI_SP: Classic planning poker — one number from Fibonacci scale (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21).
projectSettings.methodDesc_HOURS: Team votes in hours. Median is rounded up to a sane value and converted to days.
projectSettings.methodDesc_DAYS: Team votes in days (0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13). Median is rounded up to a sane value.
projectSettings.workingHoursPerDayDesc: Used to convert hours into days on reveal.

landing.headline: Plan sprints together. Estimate smarter.
landing.subheadline: Collaborative task estimation with Dev, QA and BA criteria. Visual Gantt chart for sprint planning. Real-time sync for the whole team.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for sprint planning
landing.featuresSubtitle: From estimation to Gantt chart — one tool for the entire team.
landing.feature1Desc: 4 criteria: Dev Effort, QA Effort, Risk, Uncertainty. Median-based Story Points recommendation. Real-time team voting.
landing.feature2Desc: Drag-and-drop planning. Multi-row parallel tasks. Auto-adjust around time-offs and weekends.
landing.feature3Desc: Real-time updates for all participants. Multiple Scrum Masters. DEV, QA, BA roles.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up as Scrum Master and create your first project.
landing.step2Desc: Share an invite link. Members choose their role: DEV, QA or BA.
landing.step3Desc: Run estimation sessions, build the Gantt chart, export reports.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to plan your next sprint?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Free and open. Start planning with your team right now.
